title: Release audit: README.md still documents `.../v0.1.0/install.sh` for the install command and fo
summary: Update both documented commands to the current release installer (v0.1.1 or a versionless latest URL) and add a README guard test that asserts the install and uninstall commands use the release installer.
requirements: R1: README.md contains no reference to the `v0.1.0` install script URL (`.../v0.1.0/install.sh`), in the install command or anywhere else.
R2: The README install command and the README uninstall command reference exactly the same install-script URL, and that URL is the only install-script URL in README.md.

R3: The install-script URL in README.md points at the release whose behavior the documentation describes (the current release, i.e. the v0.1.1 release referenced by the audit finding), not at an earlier tag. The version selector appears exactly once in the URL and both commands inherit it.
R4: No other README content changes: the surrounding prose, command shape (`curl -fsSL <url> | bash`), options and section structure stay as they are, except for the URL itself.

R5: If the chosen URL names a release tag that is not yet published at commit time, the README names the newest published tag instead and the discrepancy is recorded in the task report; README must never advertise a tag that does not resolve.

R6: The existing test suite passes, and tests/test_readme_install.py either already fails on the stale URL (and therefore now passes) or is extended to assert R1 and R2 without weakening any existing assertion.
R7: No change to install.sh, forge_code/*, pyproject.toml or the release directories is introduced by this task.
acceptance: A1: A grep for `v0.1.0/install.sh` in README.md returns nothing.
A2: All install-script URLs found in README.md are identical, and there are at least two of them (one in the install command, one in the uninstall command).
A3: The version selector in the README install-script URL equals the version documented as the current release, and the URL is fetchable (HTTP 200) from the public repository.
A4: The README diff contains only URL changes, reviewable as a small, self-contained change.
A5: `python -m pytest` passes for the whole repository, including tests/test_readme_install.py.
A6: `git diff --name-only` lists only README.md and, optionally, tests/test_readme_install.py.
plan_goal: Fix install.sh so a new terminal finds forgel-code on PATH

command: awk '/^### Update$/{f=1;next} /^#/{f=0} f' README.md | grep -Fx -e 'curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forgel-dev/code/main/install.sh | sh'
awk '/^### Uninstall$/{f=1;next} /^#/{f=0} f' README.md | grep -Fx -e 'curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forgel-dev/code/main/install.sh | sh -s -- --uninstall'
test "$(git show --name-only --format= HEAD | sed '/^$/d' | sort | tr '\n' ' ')" = "README.md tests/test_cli.py tests/test_readme_install.py "

for p in install.sh tests/test_install.py tests/test_check_cleanup.py CHANGELOG.md; do git show --name-only --format= HEAD | grep -qxF "$p" && exit 1; done; for p in install.sh tests/test_install.py tests/test_check_cleanup.py; do test -n "$(git status --porcelain -- "$p")" || exit 1; done; exit 0

result.summary: README.md now documents exactly one install-script URL, the versionless canonical `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forgel-dev/code/main/install.sh`, in the install, update and uninstall commands; the three `/v0.1.1/install.sh` occurrences were replaced, no `/v<tag>/install.sh` path remains, and the surrounding prose, command shape (`| sh`, `| sh -s -- --uninstall`), options and section structure are untouched. tests/test_readme_install.py's text-only guard (`assert_single_install_script_url`) rejects a stale `v0.1.0` install-script path, any tag-pinned `/v<tag>/install.sh` path, fewer than two install-script URLs and any URL other than the single canonical string, proven through `assertRaises` on the guard's own helpers in test_stale_install_script_url_is_rejected, test_divergent_install_script_url_is_rejected, test_another_branch_install_script_url_is_rejected, test_a_missing_install_script_url_is_rejected and test_rejects_a_stale_url_anywhere_in_the_document; the module imports only re, unittest and pathlib, so it needs no network. tests/test_cli.py's ReadmeTest now asserts the canonical versionless URL, rejects tag-pinned install paths and no longer rejects the default branch. CHANGELOG.md, install.sh, tests/test_install.py and tests/test_check_cleanup.py were left as found (CHANGELOG.md has no net diff against HEAD) and the scratch probe file the earlier attempt created was deleted. assumptions: The specification v3 (versionless default-branch URL, FR-1 to FR-11) governs where the older task-contract R1-R3 text named a v0.1.1 tag; the reviewer feedback demands the same, so README, the guard and ReadmeTest all use https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forgel-dev/code/main/install.sh.

last_failure.message: R10 and the Technical Requirements say 'the commit is performed by the runtime, not by the agent (the agent's git is read-only)' and that only the three named paths are compared, but they never say how the runtime identifies those paths in a worktree that legitimately contains unrelated pre-existing modifications (install.sh, tests/test_install.py, tests/test_check_cleanup.py). The runtime's commit-selection step therefore reports 'the completion step could not decide which uncommitted files belong to the task', the repository stays uncommitted, and the acceptance item 'the task repository is committed' plus AC9 (commit contains exactly README.md, tests/test_readme_install.py, tests/test_cli.py) can never pass. Rewrite R10 and the Technical Requirements so that the completion contract is explicit and self-executing: the agent itself finishes by staging and committing exactly README.md, tests/test_readme_install.py and tests/test_cli.py with a path-limited `git add --` / `git commit -- <paths>` (or equivalent) that never adds install.sh, tests/test_install.py, tests/test_check_cleanup.py or CHANGELOG.md; the commit message states the README install-command fix without tool attribution; the agent verifies with `git show --name-only --format= HEAD` that the commit lists exactly those three paths and reports the commit hash and the remaining dirty files in its report. Drop the statement that the agent's git is read-only and the statement that the runtime performs the commit, keep the rule that the whole working tree is never committed, and leave FR-1 to FR-11 and all acceptance checks unchanged so the existing README canonical-URL work remains valid.

result.last_summary: README.md now documents one install-script URL, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forgel-dev/code/v0.1.1/install.sh, in the `## Install` command, the `### Update` command and the `### Uninstall` command (`| sh -s -- --uninstall`); the only README change is the URL in those lines, so no `.../v0.1.0/install.sh` reference remains. tests/test_cli.py's `ReadmeTest::test_readme_has_a_pinned_install_command` now pins the full v0.1.1 command instead of the v0.1.0 URL. CHANGELOG.md keeps exactly one English `## [Unreleased]` bullet recording the fix. tests/test_readme_install.py keeps the text-only guard built from the single `INSTALL_TAG = "v0.1.1"` constant and gains the two named rejection tests required by the spec: `test_stale_install_script_url_is_rejected` feeds the guard's own `assert_single_install_script_url` a document carrying `/v0.1.0/install.sh`, and `test_divergent_install_script_url_is_rejected` feeds it a document whose second install-script URL names another tag; both require the same assertion the positive path uses to raise, so the guard is proven by behaviour rather than message wording. The module imports only `re`, `unittest` and `pathlib` and fetches nothing. Verified with `python -m unittest -v tests.test_readme_install tests.test_cli.ReadmeTest` (37 tests OK) and the full `python -m unittest discover -s tests` (211 tests OK, ~141 s). Note: the documented installer URL currently answers HTTP 404 because the v0.1.1 tag is not published yet; that is recorded under spec_issues.; uncommitted files outside the contract: install.sh, tests/test_check_cleanup.py, tests/test_install.py

spec_issues.requirement: Task contract R3 requires the README install-script URL to carry a version selector naming the current release tag (v0.1.1).
spec_issues.problem: Specification v3 FR-1 to FR-3 require the versionless default-branch URL and forbid any /v<tag>/install.sh path; the two contracts are mutually exclusive, and the tag v0.1.1 is not published in this repository (only v0.1.0 exists).
spec_issues.proposal: Keep the versionless default-branch URL requirement (specification v3) and restate R3 in the task contract as 'the URL points at the default branch and never names a release tag'.

checks.output: the task repository still has the task's uncommitted files: README.md, tests/test_cli.py, tests/test_readme_install.py
